title: Austin: Police, Law, & Finance
summary:
*   **City Budget Worksession:** The meeting was solely dedicated to a budget worksession, signaling a deep dive into the city's financial planning.
*   **Police Department Focus:** Discussions centered on the Police Department's budget, including a five-year plan to expand the force and the critical need to replace outdated equipment.
*   **Financial and Legal Reviews:** Council reviewed budget proposals for the Financial Services Department (including a revenue update) and the Law Department.

BUDGET WORKSESSION
-
Mayor Todd called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Mayor Pro Tem Urdy and Councilmember Epstein. The Mayor announced the purpose of the
meeting was to hold a budget worksession.
POLICE
Police Chief Jim Everett introduced his staff and disucessed their department budget,
referring to charts. Copies of the charts are on file in the City Clerk's office. There
was a discussion of additions to the Police force and the five-year plan for adding to the
force. Chief Everett also told Council that much of their equipment is old and will need
replacement.
(At this point Mayor Todd left the meeting.)
REVENUE UPDATE AND FINANCIAL SERVICES
Betty Dunkerley, Director of Finance, went over the Revenue Update information. Copy of
charts used are on file in the City Clerk's office. Mrs. Dunkerley also reviewed the
Financial Services budget. LAW DEPARTMENT City Attorney Iris Jones and Assistant City
Attorney Diana Granger discussed the Law Department budget and used charts to illustrate.
MEETING ENDED At 11:55, the meeting lost its Council quorum, but continued until 12:05
